observations.seen: Monochrome photograph captioned Worshipers under the canvas Tabernacle: broad sloping fabric roof with radial seam/tension lines, tall round supports, broad open perimeter and seated congregation. Lantern posts and people will not be modeled.
observations.limits: Eastern Massachusetts analogue; no original hue, outer guy layout, exact roof diameter, or measured pole schedule can be inferred. Text dates recurring giant tent to 1870; NPS nomination gives 1869. Use circa 1869–70 without resolving that discrepancy.

observations.seen: Original printed text describes canvas white tabernacles in the 1853 Philadelphia narrative.
observations.limits: Earlier Eastern material/colour analogue, not a colour measurement of Windsor in 1872.

additional_text_read.claims: Bench and pulpit/stand at tent meetings; 1853 Philadelphia context and white canvas.
Large canvas tent on tall poles in 1869; old benches made in 1846/1851 were reused in the 1879 iron building. Do not copy later iron roof.
